summary: Explain the confirmed booking sequence and prepare a case to review

context.audience: The freelancer reviewing how bookings work

stakeholders.scope: Deposit collection, scheduling and the meaning of a completed booking
stakeholders.notes: Synthetic demonstration; no real process owner has approved this model.

scenarios.title: An accepted proposal becomes a booking
scenarios.given: The client has accepted the proposal.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The deposit arrives before scheduling; scheduling the work completes the booking.

evidence.quote: The deposit must arrive before scheduling. Booking is complete once the work is scheduled.

steps.text: The client accepts the proposal, starting the booking process.
The freelancer collects the deposit. Scheduling waits until the deposit has arrived.
The freelancer schedules the work. The booking is then complete.
